description: Space/query: filter by name (substring) and isPublic (boolean). Default sort: name ascending. Include non-member Spaces with isPublic+isPubliclyPreviewable when filtered. Space/queryChanges: standard RFC 8620 §5.6. Space/join: accept exactly one of inviteCode or spaceId. Via inviteCode: resolve, check expiry/maxUses/not-banned, add member, increment uses. Via spaceId: check isPublic/not-banned, add member. Spec: §5.10-5.12.
title: Spaces Phase 2c: Space/query, Space/join handlers
